content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working with [product_name] [version_no], using [product_name] [version_no], and I want to access my SCADA from a web browser. Is this achievable?
Could you clarify what you mean by SCADA? What's your definition of SCADA? [product_name] can't be programmed using [product_name]; it requires its dedicated software, [product_name].
I programmed the [product_name] with [product_name], and used [product_name] to design the SCADA interface. I want to access it via web browsers, not just through [product_name] runtime.

Your mention of [product_name] is not entirely clear. Do you mean an HMI device using [product_name] and [product_name] for the HMI? With [product_name], it's not possible to create a SCADA for [product_name]. Using [product_name], SCADA interfaces can be built for HMI panels.
I linked [product_name] with [product_name] following instructions from a video ([url]), and it worked well. I'm not using an HMI, I just want to add an option to open it through a browser.
Are you referring to the extended web server feature of [product_name]? Custom web pages for the extended [product_name] [version_no] web server are made with the free software [product_name].
Can [product_name] be used with [product_name] for [product_name] [version_no]? If so, could you provide a tutorial?
No, the extended web server on [product_name] [version_no] and the [product_name] software are not connected to [product_name].

Hello, It seems there's some confusion: With [product_name], you can design custom web pages and store them on the internal web server of [product_name]. These pages can then be viewed using any web browser. For this, [product_name] isn’t required—you actually can’t use [product_name] to build web pages for [product_name]. The [product_name] software comes free with the [product_name] software package. If you don't have it, downloading the latest version of [product_name] (such as [version_no]) includes it. Hope this helps!

analysis.insight_summary: Users are unclear about how [company_name] products interact for SCADA and web-based interfaces. There is confusion regarding the compatibility of [product_name] with [product_name], and which products support programming, SCADA creation, and web access. Users misinterpret the roles of different software and hardware in connecting, programming, and deploying SCADA displays via browsers.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to open and operate a SCADA interface for [product_name] [version_no] directly from a web browser, using existing configurations made in [product_name], without relying on [product_name] runtime or HMI hardware.
